tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall configure the audio output parameters of an Entertainment source for stereo reproduction by applying the stereo channel configuration defined in the Audio Policy

(Confirm an Entertainment source is reproduced on both stereo channels)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Read the audio present on the left and right output channels and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. Both the left and the right output channel carry the Entertainment audio
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4865912 processes Entertainment sources as stereo, so the observation is that both channels carry audio rather than that any audio exists.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall maintain the Entertainment source in the active playback state until a user pause or stop request or a higher-priority audio event occurs

(Confirm Entertainment playback continues until the user stops it)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Wait without issuing any request
3. Record the playback state of the Entertainment source
4. Send a pause request
5. Record the playback state again
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. No request is issued
3. The Entertainment source is still playing
4. The pause request is accepted
5. The Entertainment source is paused
tcs.reasoning: 4865915 makes continuity the requirement, so the case observes the source surviving a period of inactivity before the user stops it. The higher-priority interruption the clause also names is covered by the arbitration leaves in B1.

tcs.test_item:
The Audio Management software shall route Entertainment and Information alert audio to at least the configured front audio channels. When the active audio zone is configured for all-channel alert output, the software shall route the alert to all audio channels assigned to that zone

(Confirm alert audio reaches the front channels at minimum)

2. Trigger an Entertainment alert

1. No audio source is active
2. The alert plays
3. The front output channels carry the alert
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: Anchored at package 16 section 3 to 4865981 and 4866286 as a pair: 4865981 sets the minimum — alerts may play on all channels but at a minimum on the front — and 4866286 states the front-speaker routing for the feature. Route 2 had rejected 4865981 for saying all channels where the leaf says front; that reading came from a truncated view of the row, whose next clause is exactly the minimum the leaf states. The enablement 4866286 defers to {CFTS024} is a settings concern, so this case checks routing and not the setting, and takes no DR.

tcs.test_item:
During Entertainment source deactivation, the Audio Management software shall apply the ramp-down sequence only to the configured applied output channels as defined in the audio routing configuration

tcs.reasoning: 4866497, resolved by route 2 and reported in package 15 section 3.1. It is its own object, distinct from 4866494 that B1 used for 144: that one is the general deactivation ramp, this one is the applied-channels restriction, so no shared-anchor argument is needed. The restriction is the point, so the case observes which channels are left alone as much as which ramp.

tcs.test_item:
During Entertainment source deactivation, the Audio Management software shall update the remaining output channels according to the configured audio routing policy after completing the ramp-down sequence

(Confirm the channels outside the applied set ramp down on their own parameter)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Trigger an Information source that applies to a subset of channels
3. Measure the ramp-down on the channels outside the applied set and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. The Information source becomes active
3. The Entertainment audio on the remaining channels ramps down within 25 ms to 50 ms
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: Anchored at package 16 section 3 to 4866498, which runs consecutively with 145's 4866497 as the two halves of the attenuate branch: applied channels first, remaining channels after. Route 2 missed it by searching the singular remaining channel where the spec writes remaining audio channels. The parameter here is <Tent Ramp Down>, which is defined at 4867767, so the bound is real — it is not the undefined <Temp Ramp Down> that 204 and 207 carry a PENDING for. The channel set itself is defined in {CIP Radio DSPPP}, outside this feature's scope under R-AM5, so it is not restated.

tcs.test_item:
While cabin audio is active, the Audio Management software shall determine the default alert playback volume as 15 dB below the current cabin audio level or the equivalent of volume step 6, whichever is greater

(Confirm the alert sits the specified interval below a louder cabin level)

2. Trigger an alert
3. Read the cabin audio level and the alert level and record them
tcs.expected_result:

2. The alert plays
3. The alert level is 15 dB below the cabin audio level
tcs.reasoning: 4866207 sets the default as the greater of two candidates, so the two branches need a case each. This is the branch where the cabin level is high enough that 15 dB below it wins. Out-of-pool anchor, single-source under R-AM18.

tcs.test_item:
While cabin audio is active, the Audio Management software shall determine the default alert playback volume as 15 dB below the current cabin audio level or the equivalent of volume step 6, whichever is greater

(Confirm the alert falls back to the floor when the cabin level is low)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play a cabin audio source at a level near the minimum
2. Trigger an alert
3. Read the cabin audio level and the alert level and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. The cabin audio plays at the set level
2. The alert plays
3. The alert level is the equivalent of volume step 6
tcs.reasoning: The other branch of the whichever is greater rule at 4866207: with the cabin level low, 15 dB below it falls under step 6 and the floor takes over. Testing only the first branch would leave the floor unexercised, which is the branch that protects audibility. Out-of-pool, single-source under R-AM18.
